{{Quote|The Trade Federation brought us into the Republic, though they did so at the expense of my world's resources.|[[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]], to [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]|<ref name="Cloak of Deception" />}}
'''Mirial''' was a cold, dry planet located near the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]].<ref name="Holonet">''{{HolonetOld|inhabitants|mirialan|Mirialan}}''</ref> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialans]],<ref name="TCSWE" /> including [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|luminaraunduli|Unduli, Luminara}}</ref>

==History==
The Mirialans joined the [[galactic community]] prior to [[3951 BBY]]. During the [[Jedi Civil War]], Mirial aligned with the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]], returning to the Republic after [[Darth Malak]]'s death. 

When the [[Great Galactic War]] began, Mirial became a safe haven for many refugees from the Outer Rim.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

At the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a tectonic gap on Mirial revealed an underground [[City/Legends|city]] with ineffable riches.<ref name="Mission" />

The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] later fought in a [[Mirialan War|war]] against a neighboring planet, and triumphed, thanks in part to [[Arwen Cohl]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.

The planet was later under the control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
